reason: I'd forward a few nota to the free 30 to see if it reads them, but it sounds built for one business dumping everything into one sheet, and I have 20 clients whose receipts can never mix. With 20 clients I'm easily past 500 documents a month, so I'd be paying $79 out of maybe $1,600 I earn, and I still don't know if it separates anything.
objection: One account, one Google Sheet. I have 20 clients and every one needs its own sheet and its own group, kept apart. If I have to sort the rows by hand afterwards I haven't saved anything.
would_change_my_mind: A bookkeeper plan where each client's chat goes into that client's own sheet automatically, priced so I can pass the cost on to clients, like a few dollars per client a month.
